As Apple continues to expand support for its Car Keys feature across the automotive industry, the feature appears to be heading to select models from a major Chinese automaker. Here's what we know.

Apple Wallet's Car Keys Feature Reportedly Coming to GWM Tank

According to code spotted by MacRumors, new backend code suggests Apple's Car Keys feature may soon expand support to Tank models from Great Wall Motors (GWM).

Great Wall Motors already supports Apple CarPlay in several models, including the Tank 300, Tank 400, Tank 500, and Tank 700, as well as vehicles from its Haval, Ora, Wey, and Poer brands.

However, no models currently support the Car Keys feature. Users can lock, unlock, and start supported vehicles using their iPhone or Apple Watch.

This news comes just days after backend code indicated Car Keys would support Volkswagen models, and Apple continues to expand the feature's reach after earlier rollouts with Toyota and Rivian.

Apple announced in 2025 that 13 additional automakers would gain Car Keys support, including Wey (a GWM brand), as well as Acura, Cadillac, Chery, Chevrolet, GMC, Hongqi, Lucid, Porsche, Rivian, Smart, Tata Motors, and Voyah.

According to Apple's website, more than 800 car models currently support CarPlay, with 52 of those also supporting Car Keys. For a complete compatibility list, check out this link.
